blocks.text: Era Zero now has 315 canonical roots and 9 provisional roots in 1 nine-root chunk. No completed review packet awaits a decision. The broad English translator remains blocked. A restricted explicit-ID renderer may cover only the 315 canonical roots and must reject provisional meanings, unapproved compounds, and underspecified grammar.

The final semantic block is ORI:200–222. After that packet, a full Origin-family audit and complete regression are required. Gate 4, the compound architecture, and translator implementation remain deferred.
